modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
follow safe working practices while dealing with hazards to ensure safety of self and others
use appropriate protective clothing/equipment for specific tasks and work
follow appropriate safety practices while working in and around trenches, elevated places and confined areas
lift heavy objects safely using correct procedures
carry out routine check of the machine for identifying potential hazards
report any identified breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person

pcs.pc_description: use appropriate type of fire extinguisher

provide appropriate first aid procedure to victims wherever required eg.in case of bleeding, burns, choking, electric shock etc.

follow regular cleaning and disinfection practices at work place using appropriate techniques and materials

avoid contact with ill people and self-isolate in a similar situation
follow the fundamentals of 5S for housekeeping
ensure good housekeeping in order to prevent hazards and accidents
store the material, tools and equipment in the correct location and in good condition
segregate waste into different categories
identify recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous waste
dispose non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste appropriately at identified location
identify ways to optimize usage of material in various tasks/activities/processes
check for spills/leakages in various tasks/activities/processes
plug spills/leakages and escalate to appropriate authority if unable to rectify
check if the equipment/machine is functioning normally before commencing work and rectify wherever required
ensure electrical equipment and appliances are properly connected and turned off when not in use

modules.module_title: Identify positions for setting up the scaffold

pcs.pc_description: Identify where to erect structures for scaffolding according to the needs of the welder, fitter or other team member
Identify which position will be appropriate to set up scaffold
Check power lines or conductors in close proximity to the position of the intended scaffold
Ensure safety measures are maintained
Identify any defects and carry out emergency damage control

modules.module_title: Checks before and during erection of scaffolding

pcs.pc_description: • Check the following points before and during erection of scaffolding: • • Ensure that all necessary permits and instructions or information relating to the job prior to commencing erection are available • • Inform concerned authority on site before commencing erection • • Examine the building or structure against which scaffolding is carried out and in case of doubt about any aspect of the job.
Identify and select the required scaffolding equipment and place it near the work area
Place suitable sills and ensure there are no holes and foreign objects under the sills and the ground is level
Ensure cross-bracing to prevent the staging swaying back and forth
Ensure next level frames are tightly locked in the lower-level staging
Plan for the weight that the planks will have to carry
Identify and use appropriate clamp pipes and other tools to erect structures for scaffolds
Ensure safety measures are followed
Identify any deviations and inform supervisor if the problem needs to be escalated

modules.module_title: Checks during the use of scaffolding

pcs.pc_description: • Check the following during the use of scaffolds: • • The frames are correctly aligned and properly supported at their bases • • There is no undue deflection in ledgers and transoms or putlogs • • No essential member of the structure has been removed • • All ties and braces are in place and are effective in stabilising the structure • • All couplers are tightened properly • • All scaffold planks are sound and are properly supported

modules.module_title: Dismantling the scaffold structure post completion of job

pcs.pc_description: Examine and check before dismantling the scaffold that all ties and bracings are effectively in position
Suitable warning notices must be displayed for safety at the work site
Ensure dismantling progressively from the top level downwards
Remove ties, braces, ledgers, transoms, planks and guardrails lift by lift with standards following as joint positions are reached
Avoid mishandling of scaffold materials and stack properly
Ensure batch wise tag marking of the scaffold materials for storing purpose
Ensure that all scaffolding materials are removed from the work site and no loose materials are left over
